title: Maximum initial kinetic energy
description: Essential: States that the maximum initial kinetic energy is given by the photoelectric equation: E_km = hν - W₀.

title: Velocity range at O
description: Essential: Correctly states the lower and upper bounds for v₀: sqrt(2eU/m) ≤ v₀ ≤ sqrt(2(hν + eU - W₀)/m).

title: Velocity and angle from plate M
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v_M = sqrt(eU/m) and the angle β = 30° for part (3).

title: Force balance in Region I
description: Important: Applies the velocity selector condition (eE = ev₀B₁) to relate E, B₁, and v₀.

title: Energy conservation for acceleration
description: Important: Uses the work-energy theorem (½mv₀² - ½mv_M² = eU) to relate velocities before and after acceleration.

title: Magnetic geometry in Region II
description: Important: Derives the geometric constraint from circular motion in Region II: (mv₀ sin α)/(eB₂) = a/2.

title: Maximum E and B₂ derivation
description: Important: For part (4), correctly maximizes E and B₂ using the upper bound for v₀ and the condition sin α = 1.

title: Y-velocity kinetic energy limit
description: Optional: Recognizes that the y-component of initial kinetic energy cannot exceed E_km: ½m(v₀ sin α)² ≤ hν - W₀.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of forces in the velocity selector or the sign of the electron charge in Lorentz force.

title: Incorrect trigonometric relation
description: Pitfall: Fails to correctly relate the emission angle β, the angle α at O, and the velocities v_M and v₀ via v_M sin β = v₀ sin α.
